newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: SENIOR EXECUTIVES TO LEAVE FLETCHER.
newsitem.headline: SENIOR EXECUTIVES TO LEAVE FLETCHER.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Ltd said on Tuesday two senior executives had separately decided to leave the group towards the end of the year.
Ian Donald is the Chief Financial Officer and a director of Fletcher Challenge. John Hood is the Chief Executive of Fletcher Challenge Paper.
Both men were considered front contenders for the appointment of chief executive of FCL, which recently went to Michael Andrews, following the decision of Hugh Fletcher to step down.

"The group regrets losing the talents of these long-serving executives, but understands that each has reached a point in time where it is sensible for him to pursue new challenges" Hugh Fletcher said.
Announcements on their replacement will occur closer to the end of the year.
